requirements.text: Allow customers to book their appointments online, select services, barbers, and available time slots.
Implement automated reminders to customers before their appointments to minimize no-show occurrences.
Enable barbers to manage their own availability while avoiding confusion in scheduling.
Provide daily and weekly summaries of bookings, cancellations, and peak times to assist in decision-making.
A clear list of services with brief descriptions for customers to understand what each service entails.
Customers should have the ability to choose their preferred barber, along with a display of each barber's availability.
Customers should be able to cancel or reschedule their appointments online to enhance convenience and reduce disruptions.
Send first reminder 24 hours before the appointment.
Send second reminder one hour before the appointment.
Barbers should have their own login credentials to access and manage their schedules.
Barbers should be able to update their availability, including hours, breaks, and days off, in real time without needing to go through the owner.
Barbers should have the ability to block off specific times when they are unavailable, preventing double bookings.
Provide a simple and intuitive interface for barbers to view their upcoming appointments and make adjustments easily.
Track the number of appointments for each day and week to identify trends and plan for busy periods.
Track data on how many appointments are cancelled or missed to identify patterns and address issues.
Provide insights into the busiest days and times to optimize staff scheduling and consider promotional strategies.
Provide information on which services are booked most frequently to inform marketing and service offerings.
Provide insights into repeat customers to enhance relationships and loyalty.
Present data in a clear and easy-to-read format for proactive decision-making.
System must comply with data protection regulations to ensure the safety and confidentiality of customer personal information.
